def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    rL=[r for r in range(H) if all(x==8 for x in g[r])]
    cL=[c for c in range(W) if all(g[r][c]==8 for r in range(H))]
    rb=[];prev=0
    for l in rL+[H]:
        if l>prev: rb.append((prev,l)); prev=l+1
    cb=[];prev=0
    for l in cL+[W]:
        if l>prev: cb.append((prev,l)); prev=l+1
    def blk(idx,bl):
        for k,(a,b) in enumerate(bl):
            if a<=idx<b: return k
    m2=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==2]
    m3=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==3]
    i2,j2=m2[0]; i3,j3=m3[0]
    # vertical 2-line: block col of 2-marker; extend from its block up/down one block per side
    bc2=blk(j2,cb)
    top=max(0,bc2-1); bot=min(len(cb)-1,bc2+1)
    for bj in range(top,bot+1):
        c0,c1=cb[bj]
        for r in range(rL[0] if False else 0,0): pass
    # simpler: iterate bands between the two 2-marker bands, extended by one band each side
    a_i,a_j=i2,j2; 
    # find 2-marker bands
    bdi=blk(i2,rb); bdj=blk(a_i,rb)
    # determine band extent: from first marker band to last + expand one band on each side
    marks=sorted({blk(i,rb) for i,_ in m2})
    ext=list(range(min(marks)-1,max(marks)+2))
    bcd=marks[0]
    for bi in range(min(ext),max(ext)+1):
        r0,r1=rb[bi]
        for c in range(cb[bcd][0],cb[bcd][1]):
            out[r][c]=2
    # horizontal 3-line similarly
    marks3=sorted({blk(i,rb) for i,_ in m3})
    bcl=sorted({blk(j,cb) for _,j in m3})
    ext3=sorted(set(range(max(0,min(marks3)-1),min(len(rb)-1,max(marks3)+2))))
    bcr=marks3[0]
    for bj in range(min(bcl),max(bcl)+1):
        c0,c1=cb[bj]
        for r in range(rb[bcr][0],rb[bcr][1]):
            out[r][c]=3
    # intersections -> 6: bands of 2-line intersecting block cols of 3-line
    inter=set(ext) & {bcr}
    icols=set(range(min(bcl),max(bcl)+1))
    for bi in sorted(inter):

            r0,r1=rb[bi]; c0,c1=cb[bj]
            for r in range(r0,r1):
                for c in range(c0,c1):
                    out[r][c]=6
    return out
